[[File:Stats.jpg|right|150px]] At every level advancement the character gains a number of '''Skill points''' to spend on their Hero and Tower '''Stats''', as shown by the [[Experience Guide]]. A player can spend up to 1000 (985 on PC) skill points in a single stat. Equipment stats will further boost the amount of points. On PC, a single stat cannot exceed 16,000 but is neigh impossible to achieve legitimately. By hovering the mouse over one of the stats, the player can see how many skill points allocated to it as well as the sum of points provided by the hero's equipment. On Console, the maximum amount of hero skill points allowed to be invested into a single stat is +120, while hero speed is capped at +70, and the maximum amount of skill points you get in total at level 90 is 459. ==Types== Stats are commonly divided into three types: Hero, Abilities and Towers/Defenses: *'''Hero Stats''' affect the heroes themselves. There are four in total: [[Hero Health]], [[Hero Damage]], [[Hero Speed]] and [[Hero Casting Rate]]. *'''Ability Stats''' increase the effectiveness of the specified hero abilities. Most heroes have two activated abilities. *'''Defense Stats''' affect the defenses, or towers, the hero places. There are four in total: [[Defense Health]], [[Defense Base Damage]], [[Defense Area of Effect]] and [[Defense Attack Rate]]. [[Damage Resistance|Resistances]] are exclusively granted by equipped armor and shields, capping at 90% damage reduction per damage type. On [[Nightmare (Difficulty)|Nightmare]] and [[Ascension (Difficulty)|Ascension]], damage resistances are reduced by 45%.
